name: Cubing in Campbellsville 2023
information: All proceeds from this competition will be going to the family of Bryson Skaggs. Bryson was a 2023 graduate of Taylor County High School. He was involved in a car crash on August 4th, 2023 and sadly passed away. We will be holding cube raffles throughout the day to raise money for his family. | | | -------- | This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcTlRIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dcc0259d7351edebf44a45c22567906011bb652a/image.png)
